title: Core module with focused tests
purpose: Create or update one Samantha core module with focused unit tests and deterministic verification.
useWhen: The task changes core harness behavior without adding or changing a CLI command.
The behavior can be isolated to one src/core module and one focused test file.
The implementation can be verified with typecheck and Bun tests.

task.title: Implement <module> core behavior
task.instructions: Add the smallest core module implementation that satisfies this task. Start with focused behavior tests in tests/<module>.test.ts, then implement src/core/<module>.ts. Treat references/playbooks/verification-duplication.md vocabulary as advisory planning only: harness verifyCommands remain the acceptance gate, and WORKER_VERIFY_EVIDENCE may disclose worker self-checks or skipped broad checks but cannot waive declared verification. Keep the change inside the core module boundary. Do not add CLI surface, hidden memory, promoted learning artifact edits, or unscoped authority surfaces outside the declared target files.
